svg.aria-label: Parts of one model. The whole brain and each lobe run their own standardization, PCA, normative models and likelihood. The whole-brain part gives the global brain age, the lobes give regional brain ages. The global brain age feeds BrainLOSS of every part, the lobes included; the regional brain ages do not.
